tools.description: List all projects with their record ids
tools.name: list_projects

project_id.description: Record id to use with other tools (e.g. "project:abc123def")

tools.description: Persist the default project and branch for this MCP session so follow-up tool calls can omit project_id and use the current branch by default
tools.name: set_active_project

tools.description: Register a canonical story fact (pull result, stat change, item, ability) for contradiction detection. scene_id is optional: omit it to register a fact decided during planning but not yet dramatised (placed by book_number/chapter_number only), then attach it later with bind_canonical_fact_to_scene

context.description: Optional context about where/how this fact was established.

key.description: Unique key identifying the fact (e.g. "Kael:Muscle Memory").

scene_id.description:
The scene that dramatises the fact. Optional: omit it to register a
fact decided during PLANNING but not yet dramatised (e.g. a name
locked by author decision before its scene exists). Such a fact is
planned-and-pending — placed by book_number/chapter_number only — and
can be attached to its scene later with bind_canonical_fact_to_scene.

secrecy.description:
Secret-knowledge gating (design §2.1): when present, the fact is marked
`secret = 1`, its `concealment_note` is stored, and one knowledge_fact
row is written per `holder_id` linking that character into the fact's
circle of trust with `learned_at = None` (known from the start).

concealment_note.description:
Optional guidance rendered into the envelope when the fact ships to the
model.

holder_ids.description: Characters who know the fact at declaration time (the initial circle).

supersedes_fact_id.description: If this fact supersedes a previous one, supply the old fact's id.

tools.name: register_canonical_fact

tools.description: Import chapter scene text from a source file into active-branch scenes
tools.name: pull_chapter_from_file

tools.description: Export active-branch chapter scene text to a source file and store source offsets
tools.name: push_chapter_to_file

tools.description: List configured model agents and their route assignments
tools.name: list_agents

tools.description: List the embedded Spindle workflow skills and craft references. Tool equivalent of browsing bible://skills/* and bible://references/*; use get_skill / get_reference to read one.
tools.name: list_skills

tools.description: Return the full content of an embedded Spindle skill. Tool equivalent of reading bible://skills/{name}; call this to load a workflow such as scene-writer or character-creator.
tools.name: get_skill

tools.description: Return the full content of an embedded craft reference. Tool equivalent of reading bible://references/{name}.

name.description: Reference name from list_skills, or contracts/tools/v1/<tool> for a full response schema.

tools.name: get_reference

tools.description: Return a branch-aware re-anchor packet with current cursor state, constraints, subjects, recent scenes, overlays, divergence warnings, and recent activity Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_writer_state (also available through get_reference).

at_scene_id.description:
Optional explicit scene cursor. When omitted, Spindle derives the cursor
from the most recent written scene on the branch.

branch_id.description: Optional explicit branch. Defaults to the active branch.

budget_tokens.description: Preferred token budget for markdown rendering metadata.

include_recent_activity.description: Include derived recent activity. Defaults to true.

include_subjects.description: Include derived subject snapshots. Defaults to true.

project_id.description: Record id returned by create_project (for example "project:abc123def")

recent_activity_limit.description: Maximum number of recent activity entries to include. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_writer_state

tools.description: Assemble standards, novel, and scene context using chapter_id or explicit book_number and chapter_number Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_scene_context (also available through get_reference).

budget_tokens.description:
Preferred token budget for temporary inline trimming. Mandatory hard
constraints may expand the effective budget rather than being dropped.

max_character_count.description:
Optional opt-in cap for resolved scene characters. When omitted, all
requested characters are included. If set, the first N character ids in
caller order are used for the scene-layer roster and character-dependent
briefings.

sections.description:
Optional section filter. When omitted, the full scene context is
returned. Supported top-level groups: "standards", "novel", "scene".
Supported novel sections: "reader_contract", "world_rules",
"system_overlays", "timeline_briefing", "future_knowledge_briefing",
"pacing_directives", "narrative_promises_due", "knowledge_briefing",
"semantic_references", "previous_scene_tail". Supported scene sections:
"location",
"world_state", "characters", "relationships", "agency_check".

token_budget.description: Legacy budget field retained for backwards compatibility.

tools.name: get_scene_context

tools.description: Resolve one entity by table and record id as a polymorphic subject snapshot Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_entity (also available through get_reference).

branch_id.description: Optional explicit branch. Defaults to the active branch.

entity_id.description: Record id for the requested entity (for example "character:abc123def")

project_id.description: Record id returned by create_project (for example "project:abc123def")

table.description: Subject table kind for the requested entity.

tools.name: get_entity

tools.description: Assemble a compact pre-write briefing with continuity sheets, recent summaries, chapter plans, and lean scene context Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_chapter_briefing (also available through get_reference).

budget_tokens.description: Preferred token budget for temporary inline trimming.

recent_chapter_limit.description: Number of prior chapter summaries to include, newest first. Defaults to 3.

token_budget.description:
Token budget passed through to the bundled scene-context slice.
Defaults to the service's chapter-briefing budget when omitted.

tools.name: get_chapter_briefing

tools.description: Create or update a scene draft using chapter_id or explicit book_number and chapter_number; accepts content as an alias for full_text

authorship.description:
Use assistant for prose composed or revised by the host AI. Human by
default. Enables opt-in learning from a later human edit, not AI edits.

book_number.description: Optional explicit book placement. When omitted, provide `chapter_id`.

chapter_id.description:
Optional chapter reference. When provided, Spindle resolves book/chapter
placement from the existing chapter instead of requiring numeric fields.

chapter_number.description: Optional explicit chapter placement. When omitted, provide `chapter_id`.

generation_id.description: Optional receipt ID from `continue_generation` (required for `explicit` prose).

Secret-knowledge gating (design §2.3.1, the reveal path): when set, this
knowledge row grants the character membership in the circle of trust for
the referenced secret canonical fact. The id must reference an existing
canonical fact with `secret = 1`. `None` for ordinary knowledge.
